question.text: What is the minimum investment from any investor in a private placement of InvIT units?

explanation.text: The Logic: Under InvIT Regulations, for a private placement of InvIT units, the minimum investment from any investor shall be Rs. 1 crore. The Trap: Rs. 25 lakh is the trading lot for privately placed InvIT units, not the minimum investment, and the Rs. 10,000-15,000 range relates to the minimum subscription for public offers -- not private placements. Note: Keep the three thresholds distinct: private-placement minimum investment Rs. 1 crore; private-placement trading lot Rs. 25 lakh; public-offer minimum subscription Rs. 10,000-15,000.
